From \(2\sqrt{mn}=\sqrt{2011^2-1}\), squaring gives  
\[
4mn=2011^2-1.
\]
With \(m+n=2011\), the numbers \(m,n\) are roots of  
\[
t^2-2011t+\frac{2011^2-1}{4}=0.
\]
Its discriminant is  
\[
2011^2-(2011^2-1)=1,
\]
so the roots are  
\[
\frac{2011\pm 1}{2}=1006,1005.
\]
Thus \(m+n=2011\).

\[
\boxed{2011}
\]
